credentials.title: Import Huawei device credentials
credentials.description: Run the local credential helper, copy its JSON, and paste the complete JSON below. Only device ID, local auth code, model, and name are retained in Home Assistant memory for 10 minutes.

data_description.credentials_json: Paste the complete JSON copied from the credential helper.
